genTemplate.templateContent:
STATEMENT OF WORK

This Statement of Work No. {{sowNumber}} (this “SOW”) is entered into as of {{effectiveDate}} between {{partyA.name}} (“Client”) and {{partyB.name}} (“Supplier”), and is governed by the Master Services Agreement between the Parties dated {{mtaDate}} (the “MSA”). Terms defined in the MSA have the same meaning here. Where this SOW conflicts with the MSA, the MSA controls unless this SOW says otherwise and is signed by both Parties.

1. Scope

{{scope}}

2. Deliverables

    {{#each deliverables}}
  1. {{name}} — {{description}} Due: {{dueDate}}.
    2. {{/each}}

3. Out of Scope

{{outOfScope}} Anything not expressly listed in Section 2 is out of scope and requires a signed change order.

4. Schedule

Work begins on {{startDate}} and is scheduled to complete by {{endDate}}. Dates assume Client provides access, information and approvals within three business days of request.

5. Fees

{{fees}}

6. Payment Milestones

    {{#each milestones}}
  1. {{name}} — {{amount}}, payable on {{trigger}}.
    2. {{/each}}

7. Acceptance

Client will review each deliverable within five business days of delivery and either accept it or provide written notice of the specific deficiencies. A deliverable not rejected within that period is accepted.

8. Change Control

Any change to scope, deliverables, schedule or fees takes effect only through a change order signed by both Parties.

Governing Law

This Statement of Work is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules, and by the terms of the Master Services Agreement it is issued under.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this SOW as of the Effective Date.
